cause: pip records main direct wheel URL, but codex-contracts selected via --find-links has no direct_url.json. Harness wrongly required direct_url for both. Full installer report retains actual file wheel origin/digest. SDK checks preceding this provenance read ran without error; no SDK defect inferred.
resolution: Separate full-base harness accepts absent direct_url only when installer report binds dependency to retained local wheel file and exact SHA256. Original bounded harness and source candidate untouched.
